correctness.rationale: All source-theorem hypotheses hold: \(s=\beta r\), \(\alpha s=\alpha\beta r<r\), and \(0<r,s<2\). The exact transformed recurrence has stable multiplier \(1-r\) and a positive neutral variable. Stable contraction gives \(q=-\alpha\gamma y^2/r+O(y^3)\). The expansion \(y_{n+1}=y_n-\gamma y_n^2+(\gamma^2/2+\alpha\beta\gamma/r)y_n^3+O(y_n^4)\) implies \(w_{n+1}-w_n=\gamma+(\gamma^2/2-\alpha\beta\gamma/r)/w_n+O(w_n^{-2})\). After subtracting the linear term and prescribed logarithmic term, increments are summable \(O(\log n/n^2)\). Four rational-coefficient and independent trajectory checks passed; the proof, not finite tests, establishes the unbounded-time claim.

value.rationale: At the critical invasion boundary, extinction speed is a natural observable. The exact logarithmic coefficient, its parameter-dependent sign, and its zero locus distinguish distinct asymptotic relaxation regimes that global attraction and linear stability cannot differentiate. The result is global over all strictly positive initial conditions in a nontrivial parameter range, and the reciprocal trajectory has a finite corrected constant even on the cancellation locus.
